description: Ampere is a Python package for fitting and exploring battery discharge behaviour from electrochemical measurements. Its maintainer describes a scikit-learn-like interface for fitting, prediction, plotting and generation of discharge curves under chosen charge or discharge patterns. Users provide laboratory impedance or discharge observations and model settings; outputs are fitted curves and predicted battery response for the tested cell and time interval. Geographic coverage is a user-defined battery, not a mapped network. MIT source, package installation and example notebooks are public. The README calls the package alpha-stage, so accuracy and API stability need checking before operational use. A limitation is that cell-level fitted behaviour cannot by itself predict an assembled storage fleet's thermal safety, degradation or grid dispatch. Ampere can help supply storage performance assumptions to infrastructure simulation. The catalogue's model-virtual-battery-aggregator is a separate fleet-level resource. No battery data, notebook or package was downloaded.
